title: Player Heads Plus
description: Your head now drops on death, Which can also be crafted to Golden Heads!
body:
This datapack makes it so player heads drop on death! Now when you kill someone, they're player head drops. Making it a great trophy for whoever you kill. 

Along with head drops, you can craft Golden heads now!

**RECIPE**

![Golden Head Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c1ae240baf53d18ada215d0be506335209d6076f.png)

**WHEN CONSUMED**

Saturation 1.2

Absorption II for 2 mins

Rengeration III for 5 seconds
